summary: The audit checks 24 units of ITALIAN courses numbered 200 or above, taken for a letter grade where one is offered (ITALLANG courses do not count). Faculty expect a B+ or better and review lower grades. Choosing the courses with the Chair of Graduate Studies is checked by hand.

F25oQ4Gw.why: "Student must complete a minimum of 24 units of ITALIAN 200+ level coursework to fulfill PhD Minor requirements, and must consult with the Chair of Graduate Studies when selecting courses. / ITALLANG courses do not count toward the Italian PhD Minor." Grading: "PhD students in the department must take required courses for a letter grade if available". The B+ is an expectation that faculty review ("The grade stands, and the student's academic performance is monitored"), not a floor.

children.name: Courses selected with the Chair of Graduate Studies
